title: Trump admin urges returning education to states, citing $3 trillion of taxes spent and poor proficiency scores
summary: Education Secretary Linda McMahon's local radio blitz reached millions of parents as the Education Department pushes to return control to states amid dismal test scores.

title: Gov Shapiro sues Trump administration over ‘lifesaving reproductive care’ in escalating abortion battle
summary: Democrat Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro joined over 20 states suing to block Trump's new Title X conditions on life-affirming services and abortion.

title: Trump helicopter’s radio warnings went unheard before close call with passenger jet, report says
summary: Marine One's crew made repeated failed attempts to warn Reagan National before departing, leaving controllers unable to halt a commercial jet takeoff.

title: Trump keeps winning Republican primaries; his losses may be more revealing
summary: The president is 24-for-24 in Senate primaries and 214-for-218 in House races, according to a Fox News tracker

title: Trump floats renaming the Atlantic and Pacific oceans after rebranding historic lake
summary: President Donald Trump joked the Atlantic and Pacific oceans could be next after signing the executive order renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America immediately.

title: Trump administration designates three far-left groups as violent terrorist networks under new sanctions
summary: The Treasury Department sanctioned Palestine Action, Autistici Inventati and Masar Badil, freezing U.S. assets tied to violent far-left terror networks.

title: Trump renames Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’ amid intensifying US-Canada trade dispute
summary: President Donald Trump signed an order to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America,' asserting the U.S. holds most of its volume as trade tensions with Canada escalate.

title: DHS fires 3 more FEMA workers after IG report finds crew skipped homes with pro-Trump signs
summary: DHS fired three more FEMA workers after an inspector general report found crews skipped homes with Trump signs during Hurricane Milton relief.

title: Democrats hand Trump one power they spent years fighting
summary: Senate Democrats voted to give Trump limited tariff authority in exchange for Russia sanctions, a move some warn he could exploit against trade partners.

title: Maine meteorologist suffers giggle attack on live TV after prank backfires spectacularly
summary: Patrick Osborn struggled to finish his WABI weather report after a prank involving Charlie Brown audio sent him into a fit of laughter.
